notes: Additions beyond the card: DRL backtest validation (TSK, forecasting) and the backtest knowledge store (GTS, context_memory), both in packet L420-L425 and L489-L493. Reuse for the workflow and detector is classed demonstrated because each serves two families (forecasting and decision support); this is a judgment call because both families come from one stock-analysis pipeline. No LLM-side module: GPT-4o-mini is used unchanged (L463) and the system avoids fine-tuning (L419-L420). Knowledge-graph RAG (L381-L397) and yfinance access (L286-L287) are off-the-shelf and not counted; the RAG is cited to Lewis et al. and Larson and Truitt. The DRL backtester is a separate model from the LLM; whether it counts as TSK or LLM side is ambiguous, so confidence is low. Temporal validity is absent: the cross-validation split is not described as chronological (L484-L487). Decision utility is one simulated trade and is theoretical (L510-L524). Table 1 and figures are partly garbled in the PDF extraction. The card's evidence_locators were page-based and are replaced by line quotes.
